name: Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, MAY 6, 2020 -
06:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
Pursuant to the State of California Executive Orders and County Health Orders, members of the public will only be allowed to participate in meetings electronically.
Meeting can be accessed as follows:
• Channel 19 on Cox Communications
• Channel 24 on Time Warner Cable
• Channel 99 on AT&T U-Verse
• City's live webcast: https://encinitasca.gov/Government/Agendas-Webcasts
Public Comments
Public comments regarding this agenda must be submitted via email to clerk@encinitasca.gov
Comments regarding this agenda received by 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting will be read into the record at the meeting for up to three minutes or in accordance with the time period established by the Mayor/Chair.
Comments regarding this agenda received after 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting will be provided to the City Council and made a part of the meeting record.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS - NONE
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar.
*If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the April 15, 2020 Special-Closed Session Meeting, April 15, 2020 Regular Meeting, April 22, 2020 Special-Closed Session Meeting, April 22, 2020 Regular Meeting, and April 26, 2020 Special Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2020-05-06 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Analyst McShane
Approve the Warrants.
2020-05-06 Item 08B Warrants
8C.
Extend use of temporary lights at Leo Mullen Sports Park for Encinitas Express. Contact Person: Recreation Services Manager Karlen
Authorize the City Manager to execute amendment number 5, extending the compliance agreement for one additional year between the City of Encinitas and Encinitas Express for use of temporary lights at Leo Mullen Sports Park.
2020-05-06 Item 08C Extend Use of Temporary Lights at Leo Mullen Sports Park for Encinitas Express
8D.
Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Encinitas and San Diego Workforce Partnership to provide mature workers job readiness workshops at the Encinitas Community and Senior Center. Contact Person: Senior Center Manager Goodsell
Approve and authorize the City Manager, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) in substantial form as contained in Attachment 1 between the City of Encinitas and San Diego Workforce Partnership to provide mature workers job readiness workshops at the Encinitas Community and Senior Center.
2020-05-06 Item 08D MOU Between the City of Encinitas and San Diego Workforce Partnership
8E.
Authorize hardware upgrades and annual software maintenance for Granicus meeting management software. Contact Person: IT Operations Supervisor Contreras
1) Authorize the Granicus annual software maintenance renewal with Granicus, Inc. in an amount not to exceed $23,770 in FY 2020-21; and 2) Authorize the purchase of hardware from Granicus to upgrade the voting workstations and encoder in the amount of $10,380. The total contract for Granicus through FY 2020-21 will be a not-to-exceed amount of $108,912. The amount here should be through the end of the contract – FY 2021-22.
2020-05-06 Item 08E Authorize Granicus Upgrade
8F.
2019 Public Safety Power Shutoff Resiliency Allocation to Cities Grant in the amount of $129,000 for the Purchase of Two Emergency Generators. Contact Person: Chief Stein
1) Accept $129,000 in funds from the California Governor’s Office of Emergency Services (Cal OES) Public Safety Power Shutoff (PSPS) Program awarded to the City of Encinitas for the purchase of two emergency generators at Fire Stations 1 and 3; and 2) Authorize the Fire Chief, or his designee, to sign and submit all the required California Governor’s Office of Emergency Services (Cal OES) paperwork.
2020-05-06 Item 08F PSPS Grant Acceptance
8G.
Amendment 1 to contract with Hendrickson Appraisal Company Inc. for as-needed appraisal services. Contact Person: City Engineer Wimmer
Authorize the City Manager or designee, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute a contract amendment with Hendrickson Appraisal Company, Inc., in substantial form as included in Attachment 1, for as-needed appraisal services. The amendment adds $100,000 of contract authorization for a new contract not-to-exceed amount of $250,000.
2020-05-06 Item 08G Hendrickson Appraisal
8H.
Amendment 15 to the Agreement with Tyler Technologies, Inc. for the purchase of Planned Annual Continuing Education (PACE 10) Training. Contact Person: IT Applications Supervisor VanPelt
Approve Amendment 15, in substantial form as attached, in consultation with the City Attorney, and authorize the City Manager to enter into the amended agreement with Tyler Technologies, Inc. for annual PACE 10 training, beginning in FY 2019-20 in the amount of $12,625.
2020-05-06 Item 08H Tyler Amendment 15 PACE 10
8I.
Projects and Grants Update - Capital Improvement Program and Traffic Engineering Divisions. Contact Person: City Engineer Wimmer
Receive the report on the status of mobility projects and grants.
2020-05-06 Item 08I Projects and Grants Update
8J.
Temporary suspension of local permit restrictions on ABC licensed restaurants which prevent off-site sale of alcohol subject to conditions. Contact Person: Acting Director of Development Services Sapa’u
Approve Resolution No. 2020-33 titled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Suspending the Restrictions on Off-site Sale and Delivery of Alcohol by ABC Licensed Restaurants.”
2020-05-06 Item 08J Temporary Suspension of Local Permit Restrictions on ABC Licensed Restaurants
8K.
Introduction of Ordinance 2020-03, an ordinance of the City of Encinitas, amending Municipal Code Section 10.04.020 regarding Section 503.6 Security Gates. Contact Person: Acting Fire Marshal Schmidt
Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2020-03 titled “An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California Amending Municipal Code Section 10.04.020 Regarding Section 503.6 Security Gates.”
2020-05-06 Item 08K Introduction of Ordinance 2020-03 Revising Security Gates
8L.
Construction contract change order for the 1711 Eolus Avenue Storm Drain Project (CD05E). Contact Person: Senior Engineer Widelski
1) Authorize the City Manager or designee, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute Construction Change Order No. 1 in substantial form as contained in Attachment 1 and any necessary amendments and time extensions with Growth Development Marketing, Inc. (GDM, Inc.) in the amount of $69,678 to modify the installation technique for a portion of storm drain line on the 1711 Eolus Avenue Storm Drain Project. The current contract cost is $81,180. If approved, the new construction contract cost will be $150,858; and 2) Authorize an additional $10,452 in contingency to provide fifteen percent contingency on the new construction contract cost of $150,858. If approved, the total not-to-exceed amount authorized by City Council for the GDM Inc. contract including this change order would be $173,487.
2020-05-06 Item 08L Change Order Eolus Avenue Storm Drain Repair
8M.
Authorize grant applications for Active Transportation Grant Program Cycle 5. Contact Person: Principal Engineer Bankston
Authorize the City Manager, or designee, to apply for, accept and administer funding from Active Transportation Program Cycle 5 for the following projects: "Birmingham Drive Streetscape" and "Leucadia Streetscape."
2020-05-06 Item 08M Authorization to Apply for ATP Grants
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Report on Red Light Photo Enforcement. Contact Person: City Traffic Engineer Bandegan
1) Receive report on Red Light Photo Enforcement (RLPE) operation and provide direction to staff; and 2) Should City Council authorize the continuance of the program, authorize the City Manager or designee, in coordination with the City Attorney, to prepare and execute an amendment to the contract with Redflex for terms as determined by the City Council for a not-to-exceed annual amount of $122,400.
2020-05-06 Item 10A Report on Red Light Photo Enforcement
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS - NONE
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM - NONE
13.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
14.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS
15.
CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
16.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON MAY 20, 2020
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
